# StarFYI Embed Widget

> Stars, constellations, exoplanets. Embeddable widgets for any website. Zero dependencies, Shadow DOM isolation.

## Quick Start

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/starfyi-embed@1/dist/embed.min.js"></script>
<div data-starfyi="spectral-badge" data-slug="example"></div>
```

## Available Widget Types (8)

- entity: `data-starfyi="entity"`
- glossary: `data-starfyi="glossary"`
- guide: `data-starfyi="guide"`
- compare: `data-starfyi="compare"`
- search: `data-starfyi="search"`
- spectral-badge (interactive): `data-starfyi="spectral-badge"`
- magnitude-display (interactive): `data-starfyi="magnitude-display"`
- constellation-card (interactive): `data-starfyi="constellation-card"`

## Customization

- **Themes**: light, dark, sepia, auto (follows system preference)
- **Sizes**: compact (280px), default (420px), large (720px)
- **Styles**: modern, classic

```html
<div data-starfyi="spectral-badge" data-slug="example"
     data-theme="auto" data-size="compact" data-style-variant="modern"></div>
```

## Integration Methods

1. **Script tag** (recommended): `<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/starfyi-embed@1/dist/embed.min.js"></script>`
2. **iframe**: `https://starfyi.com/iframe/entity/{slug}/`
3. **oEmbed**: `https://starfyi.com/oembed?url={page_url}&format=json`
4. **Badge**: `https://starfyi.com/badge/site.svg`
